<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Oh, goodness me—I just remembered! There’s something
I’ve been meaning to tell you, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Your outfit is quite darling, muffin, but it’s just not quite
suitable for a chef...

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>A true chef should have some sort of accessory that
highlights their cleanliness and sense of style.
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,661)><$facial(2,4)>Just look at my yellow scarf! A perfect example!

<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>Why, something like my look, of course! This yellow scarf
is a particularly good example.
<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,661)>It’s important for a chef to have an accessory that
highlights their cleanliness and sense of style!
You used Transform!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,665)>Goodness gracious! I didn’t know you were so good at
doing impressions!
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,39)>Now you look just like me—quite the upgrade, sweetie!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>That yellow scarf is just like the matching ones that my
buddy and I wore... <$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,661)><$facial(2,4)>It looks great on you too!

<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$facial(2,4)>I’m sure your dishes will always be tasty from now on if you
change into that look when you cook!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,659)><$facial(2,4)>You really are quite amazing,
<$cdef(27)>, sweetie.
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>Not everyone can learn how to make <$cdef(27)>bread and <$cdef(27)>salads
so quickly!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,661)>Well, I’m sure my excellent teaching helped...but you do
really have a knack for this, sweetie.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>On that note... How would you like to learn to make
another of my special dishes?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Oh, how precious you are, saying something so sweet!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>Anyway... How would you like to learn how to make
another of my special dishes?
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>That’s the spirit! Now, let’s get started!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>That’s the spirit! Now, let’s get started!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,13)><$motion(2,838)>Sizzle, sizzle, make us drool, <$cdef(27)>hamburger steak! ♪
First, knead the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(14)> with all the love in your heart!
<$voicel(2,7)>Next up, a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1304)> is what we need to make
this sizzly, juicy dish—it’s really quite an art! ♪
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,5)>Now the song and dish are done!
I hope you had a lot of fun! ♪<$motion(2,655)>

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>So the main takeaway should be...to make <$cdef(27)>hamburger
steak, you need a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1304)>!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,807)><$facial(2,9)>Now, I may be able to cook, but I sure can’t make a
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1304)>...
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,29)>It’s for frying things over a fire, so I suppose you’ll need
a lightweight material that can withstand the heat.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,661)>Why don’t you try asking <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth where you
could find something like that?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>I’ll teach you how to use a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1304)> once you’ve
made one.
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,664)><$facial(2,4)>Just say the word when you’re ready, pumpkin!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>You’ll need your very own <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1304)> to make
<$cdef(27)>hamburger steak.
<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)>Why don’t you ask <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth</color> how to craft one?

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,38)>I’ll teach you how to use a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1304)> once you’ve
made one.
<$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,664)>Just say the word when you’re ready, pumpkin!
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,27)>It seems you managed to make a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1304)></color>!

<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,661)><$facial(2,4)>Next, try putting that <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1304)> on top of the
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1639)>.

<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>Then you should be able to make a delicious
<$cdef(27)>hamburger steak!

<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,8)><$kfacial(2)>It seems your efforts to make a <$cdef(27)>hamburger steak were
successful!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,49)>My goodness, you absorb new information just like a little
sponge cake, don’t you, sweetie?
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,664)>I’d better do my best to keep up!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>! Do you need my help
with something?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>So, this time you want to make a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1304)></color>, eh?
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>So, this time you want to make a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1304)></color>, eh?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>If you’re looking for a material that’s lightweight and can
withstand heat, then I think <$cdef(27)><$ifull(106)>’s just the ticket!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,668)>Conveniently, there’s a decent amount of <$cdef(27)><$ifull(106)> in
the ground around here!
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,14)>If you look closely—do you see some bluish metal mixed in
with the soil?
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>That’s <$cdef(27)><$ifull(106)>!

<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,9)>But you can’t use ore as-is, I’m afraid.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)>First, you’ll need to melt it down and shape it into <$cdef(27)>ingots.
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,9)><$kfacial(1)>THEN you can use it as a material for your <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1304)>.
<$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)>But what can we use to melt something so hard?<$motion(1,654)><$facial(1,1)>
You came up with a <$cdef(27)>recipe </color>for a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1304)></color>!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, I just recalled—<$cdef(27)>Machoke was looking for you. <$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>They
seemed to be in a spot of trouble.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>I’ll spend a bit more time pondering how to make
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(114)>.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)>Meanwhile, would you please go see what <$cdef(27)>Machoke has
to say?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)><$cdef(27)>Machoke was looking for you earlier. It seems they’ve got
a dilemma they need some help with.

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>I’ll keep pondering the problem of how to make
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(114)>.

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>. I got some bad
news—looks
like
we’ve
got
a
dead
end
on
our hands.
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Some kinda mega-strong fence is blockin’ off the path!
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,9)>Not even my punches could make a dent in it...
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Hey, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! I’ve been waitin’ for ya.

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>There’s some kinda super strong fence up ahead that’s
blockin’ off the way forward.

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,807)>I tried to knock it down, but my punches couldn’t even make
a dent...
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,806)>Think you could do somethin’ about it?

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,666)>What? You think you can cut that thing down like it’s a
branch on a tree? <$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,27)><$facial(4,4)>Ha! Now THAT I’d like to see!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,666)>What? You think you can cut that thing down like it’s a
branch on a tree? <$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,27)><$facial(4,4)>Ha! Now THAT I’d like to see!

<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,38)>All right, let’s jog on over to that fence! I’ll take ya to
it—try to keep up!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>The fence is this way!
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,53)>OK, here’s the fence! Looks pretty sturdy, right?

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)>You really think you can cut this thing down? Show me
what you’ve got, pal!

<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)>WHOA! You really did it! You cut that fence like it was
paper! Awesome!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,38)>Classic <$cdef(27)>! I knew you’d handle it!

<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,807)>Now we can finally go farther in, but... Is it just me or is it
ridiculously hot?
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>Seems like the heat’s comin’ from deep within. And I’m no
good with hot places...

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)>You know what they say: if ya can’t stand the heat, get
outta the tunnel! So I’ll head back now.
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>But hey, you should totally go farther in and check it out!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>Maybe you’ll meet some Pokémon who love livin’ in super
hot spots!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>Meanwhile, I should probably go cool off these fists...
<$voicel(4,3)><$emotion(4,31)>They’re startin’ to swell up from all that fence-punchin’
from earlier. Ow...
*ring ring!*

<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,14)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)>I was just poking around on the <$cdef(27)>PC when it apparently
decided to connect me with you again!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,4)>How are things on your end?

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)>Oh, you’re in a tunnel, are you? The mountains around
here all seem to be volcanoes, <$voicel(1,6)>so I’m very much inclined
to believe you that it’s hot in there!
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,13)>Oh! That reminds me!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)>Oh, you’re in a tunnel, are you? The mountains around
here all seem to be volcanoes, <$voicel(1,6)>so I’m guessing it’s awfully
hot in there too!
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,13)>Oh! That reminds me!

<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>But I’m afraid I don’t know how to actually use a
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)>...
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>That’s the type of question you should take to a Pokémon
who can manipulate fire!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>For example, there’s a Pokémon called <$cdef(27)>Magmar—they’re
all born in volcanoes much like the one you’re in now.
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>You could try making a home that would appeal to
a <$cdef(27)>Magmar!

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Then, if you’re able to meet a <$cdef(27)>Magmar, that’s your chance
to ask about a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)>.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>I’d wager they could teach you all about it!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)>Well, I won’t keep you any longer! Be careful around all
those dangerous places, won’t you?

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>It’s about melting <$cdef(27)><$ifull(106)> to make <$cdef(27)><$ifull(114)>.
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>I believe you’ll want a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)> for that!

<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>You should be able to make <$cdef(27)><$ifull(114)> by melting
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(106)> in a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)>!

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>And if you’re able to find a <$cdef(27)>Magmar, you can ask them
how to use a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)>.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>I’d wager they could teach you a lot!
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Hi there, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>... What’s up?

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Oh, you need to melt some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(106)> and make
<$cdef(27)>ingots...?
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,39)>Maaag! It-it feels so good to be relied on!

<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>It’ll take a little time, so...come by and look later, OK?
Promise me!

If you’d like to get started right away, bring a Pokémon
with you and stand in front of the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)>!

<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Th-then could you put some <$cdef(27)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)><$ifull(106)> into the
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)> at my home?
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>I’ll melt it down with my flames and make you <$cdef(27)>ingots!

You can put metal, such as <$cdef(27)><$ifull(106)>, into a
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)>.
If a Pokémon with the <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(10)> specialty notices this,
they’ll process the metal into <$cdef(27)>ingots!

<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,6)>Hi, <$cdef(27)>... Um, s-sorry to keep you
waiting...
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>I’ve melted everything you put in the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)>
and made some <$cdef(27)>ingots, so uh...have a look, if you want...

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Oh, and...I think any Pokémon who’s good at <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(10)>ing
things should be able <$voicel(4,8)>to do the stuff I do...
<$voicel(4,4)><$motion(4,805)>You could have them use the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)> too!
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,5)>But, um... You can always come ask me for help if you
need it! I don’t mind!
